析 is associated with separating things into parts and analyzing them. In [分析](../words/分析.md) ぶんせき, the whole word means analysis: examining elements or relationships to understand something.

- [分](分.md) and [割](割.md) have dividing senses; [剖](剖.md) also has a division or dissection sense; [解](解.md) includes unravelling. [切](切.md) overlaps with cutting and [破](破.md) with tearing. These are guarded for direct meaning overlaps, not because their words are interchangeable.

| わ.ける | kun | 分ける わける (divide, separate) |

剖 concerns cutting something open or separating it to examine it. In [解剖](../words/解剖.md) かいぼう, it contributes the idea of dissecting; the whole word also has a figurative "analysis" sense. Do not use 剖 as a standalone replacement for the general verb 分ける わける, "divide; separate."
- [板](板.md), board or plank, overlaps the separate へぎ board sense; it is guarded without making 析 a general replacement for 板.

## Notes

断る has additional uses involving giving notice or obtaining permission; do not translate it as
"refuse" automatically in every sentence.
[新](新.md) and [近](近.md) also contain 斤. [料](料.md) shares 米 but has a different right side.
Here, "sever" means "cut off"; the two English glosses overlap.
